title: ScenarioFlowRouterLlmResponse
description: Structured output from the Phase 10 LLM Router step. targets[].personaId must be subset of graph-discovered LlmNode candidates for that Router node.

personaId.description: Must match config.personaId of a LlmNode reachable from this Router.

reason.description: Optional short justification for logs / UI.

confidence.description: Optional; host may filter by Router.config.minConfidence.

needsClarification.description: If true, v1 may fail closed or return clarificationPrompt as assistant text (product choice).

clarificationPrompt.description: Suggested follow-up question when needsClarification is true.

branchExecutionMode.description: When Router uses all_matching + routerBranchExecution auto: run selected branches in parallel or one after another.
